articles.title: Fed builds credibility, but hawkish turn leaves investors edgy
articles.description: In a significant move, the Federal Reserve has raised interest rates for the first time since 2023, marking a shift towards a hawkish stance on inflation management. This unanimous choice has led investors to brace for more potential rate increases, generating ripple effects across asset markets. Following a surge, bond yields have retracted. Yet, the future trajectory of the Fed's monetary policy remains uncertain.

articles.title: Central Banks Flex Muscles with Interest Rate Hikes
articles.description: Kevin Warsh's unexpected rate hike marked the Fed's first in over three years, aligning with global central banks tightening policies amid persistent inflation. As the ripple effects spread, markets anticipate further hikes this year. Short-term Treasury yields soared, affecting currencies and stocks worldwide.
